title: Narrowing or region changes without character changes

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Character modification ticks do not cover interaction state such as narrowing, point, mark, and active region.
hypothesis: Changing narrowing and the active region should leave `buffer-chars-modified-tick' unchanged.
minimal_fixture: One temporary buffer with stable text.
predicted_behavior: Character tick remains stable while visible accessible range and region state change.
counterexample: A stale-edit guard using only character ticks misses interaction state changes.
derived_gym_requirement: Every action needs operation-specific preconditions beyond a universal character revision guard.
